post.yt_title: Why Pray If God Already Knows? 🙏 #shorts
post.yt_desc:
"If God already knows what I need, why pray?" Fair question. Jesus agreed that God knows: "your Father knows the things you have need of before you ask Him." Then, in the very next verse, He said: "In this manner, therefore, pray: Our Father in heaven, Hallowed be Your name." Prayer isn't giving God information. It's time with your Father. That's why Jesus prayed too.

📖 Read it yourself: Matthew 6:5–13 (NKJV)

What question should we answer next? Tell us below 👇

"In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." John 1:1 (NKJV)
